_meta.status: SAMPLE DATA - not your price list
_meta.source: Representative figures taken from a hosting partner's public pricing pages and verified on 2026-09-18. They are kept here only so the engine has something to compute against out of the box.
_meta.replace_before_use: Fork this file: put your own SKUs, your own currency and your own renewal caveat in it. Every price the app quotes is derived from this file at runtime, so nothing is hardcoded in code.
_meta.annualization_rule: Monthly price x 12 gives the yearly figure, assuming a 12-month commitment
_meta.renewal_caveat: First-year promotional prices are usually lower than renewal prices; every quote must tell the customer the renewal price as well

verify_legend.official: Taken straight from a public page and safe to put in a customer quote
verify_legend.to_verify: No published price for this exact spec; confirm with your own sales desk before quoting it, and do not present it as final
verify_legend.not_priced: We sell this but publish no unit price; it may only be mentioned in words in the blueprint, never with an amount

_meta.partnership_note: This sample lists a resold Cloudflare-powered service while the page it came from publishes no certification tier for it. Wording rule for your own catalogue: say 'Cloudflare-powered managed service' only; never claim a partnership tier you cannot point to in writing.
